name: Trans!
source:
Ami, Minori, Taiga, and Ryuuji were visiting a Shinto Shrine that is famous among those that want their loved one to return his/her feelings.  An accident occurs: the group have tumbled down the stone stairs... "What? my voice..." "Why I am in Ami's body?"...

This incident triggered a strange event: They all have switched bodies!  With Ami now in Ryuuji's body, she goes on a rampage and desires to have sex with Minori, Taiga, and even herself...

[Derived from hentailoverman of HongFire]
translation:
阿美、实里、大河和龙司正在参拜一座神社，这座神社在那些希望亲人回报他/她的感情的人中很有名。意外发生了：一行人从石阶上滚了下来……“什么？我的声音……”“为什么我会在阿美的身体里？”……

这件事引发了奇怪的事件：他们都互换了身体！阿美现在进入了龙二的身体，她变得狂暴起来，渴望与实里、大河甚至她自己发生性关系……

【源自HongFire的hentailoverman】
